ui.menu.character.name: Name
ui.menu.help.lead: The commands you can use. Type them in the chat, which K opens.
ui.menu.keys.lead: The keys of Cyrodiil RP. The game's own keys work as before.
ui.menu.key.self_wheel: Your own actions: a roll, an emote, your party
ui.menu.key.interaction_wheel: Actions towards whoever stands in front of you: a greeting, a trade, a party invitation
ui.menu.key.accept: Accept an invitation to a party or a trade, shown at the top of the screen
ui.menu.key.close: Close a window or the chat
ui.menu.hint: Q and E or the arrows switch tabs, Esc closes.
ui.menu.dice.lead: Your dice set shows on the dice board and in your rolls. Anyone may pick any set: it is only a look.
ui.menu.key.dice: Open or close the dice board
ui.menu.lore.lead: Your lore card says who your character is. You decide who sees each part of it.
ui.menu.lore.name: Your name
ui.menu.lore.preview: Your card as everyone sees it
ui.menu.lore.preview_none: Nothing on your card is public yet.
ui.menu.key.lore: Open or close your lore card
ui.menu.key.lore_look: Read the lore card of the player in front of you
